name: CIBC Dividend Visa Infinite Card

apr.notes: 21.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash (cash advances, balance transfers and CIBC Convenience Cheques) for non-Quebec residents, 21.99% for Quebec residents.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases.

categories.label: Transit and rideshare, dining and recurring payments

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back of $10 or more can be redeemed at any time as a credit to the account.

signup_bonus.description: 10% cash back on up to $2,000 in net purchases in the first 4 statements (up to $200), plus a first-year annual fee rebate.

notes: Network tier is Visa Infinite per the card name. Accelerated rates stop after $50,000 in total net annual purchases or $20,000 in the accelerated categories, whichever comes first; limits reset after the December statement.
